title: Red cell distribution width (RDW-SD)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional. The source describes red cell distribution width (RDW) in general and does not separate the CV and SD forms.

measures: Red cell distribution width (RDW) measures differences in the volume and size of your red blood cells. Healthy red blood cells are usually about the same size.
context: This measurement on its own is not enough to make a diagnosis, so RDW is usually combined with other red blood cell indices and blood tests. A normal result means the cells are about the same size.
aboveRange: A result outside the normal range means there are differences in the size of your red blood cells, which is usually reviewed together with other tests
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
